scan.pinterest_status: Official Pinterest reporting and public Pinterest inspiration were checked on 8 October 2026. Pinterest's 6 October Beauty Guides launch adds a material visual-to-action pattern: decode a reference into exact features, finishes and practical recreation steps. The Beauty Trend Report remains relevant; one public design board was accessible and repeated already-covered visual patterns, while two other boards were inaccessible.
scan.chatgpt_status: Production v2.18.0 with 715 commands was read before editing. v2.19.0 updates exactly one existing command, /beauty-trend-system, while preserving all 714 other commands, 40 executable bundles, settings, compatibility and Firefox updater controls. Repository bytes are verified; the browser-installed version remains locally observable only after userscript reload.
trends: visual inspiration to action: decode the supplied reference before generating or adapting it
beauty reference taxonomy: hero feature, placement, geometry, hairstyle or cut or color, nail shape and finish, makeup zones, materials, palette, intensity, lighting and lens
observed versus inferred separation to reduce invented details when interpreting reference imagery
recreation plans that translate a look into ordered steps, adaptation notes and suitable product categories without inventing brands
cross-format continuity across editorial, detail, product-ad and UGC variants
ongoing specificity-first beauty direction from Pinterest Beauty Trend Report 2026
public design boards repeated existing vibrant gradients, collage, risograph texture, inflated type and neon-maximalist poster systems
commands_updated: /beauty-trend-system — added visual-reference decoding, an observed/inferred split, recreation planning, product-category guidance and editorial/detail/product/UGC variants
skipped: No separate /beauty-guides command because the durable visual-to-action capability belongs inside the existing /beauty-trend-system workflow
No additional commands for individual beauty microtrends because the existing system already expresses exact feature, placement, finish, palette and identity-safe adaptation
No new commands from public design boards because gradients, collage, risograph texture, inflated typography and neon maximalism are already covered by the live catalogue
